glosses: an auction (always plural - enchères - when used in this sense in French. shortened from vente aux enchères)

examples.text: La vente aux enchères se termine lundi.
Les objets non réclamés furent vendus aux enchères.
examples.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.

examples.text: Le mobilier a été acquis lors d'une vente aux enchères.
examples.en: The furniture was bought at an auction.

examples.text: J'ai fait acquisition de ce tableau lors d'une vente aux enchères.
examples.en: I obtained the painting at an auction.

examples.text: Les fermiers en cessation de paiements devaient vendre leurs terres aux enchères.
examples.en: Farmers defaulting on loans had to auction off their land.
